body: task-2-1: Add versioned structured-finding schema + wire-boundary validator in shared/egg_contracts/review_findings.py, exported via egg_contracts/__init__.py. Defines Finding (id, role lens, FindingAnchor path+line-range or slice_level marker, one-sentence summary, required-for-blocking failure_scenario, severity {blocking,advisory}, confidence {high,medium,low}, quoted evidence, optional suggested_patch/pre_merge_obligation, additive converged_roles for S3 convergence), a FindingsPayload envelope, and validate_findings_payload().
